sloka: काम रूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाणि अनेकशः ।अन्तर्धानम् गता यक्षी मोहयन्ति स्व मायया ॥१-२६-१९॥
transliteration: kāma rūpadharā sā tu kṛtvā rūpāṇi anekaśaḥ ।antardhānam gatā yakṣī mohayanti sva māyayā ॥1-26-19॥

translations.english: Capable of assuming forms at will, that yakshini intending to delude the princes through her power of magic, vanished from the sight. She then assumed various forms and released a rain of rocks. And started moving about frightfully.
